main.description: A message in a room. Written to the author's repo.

room.description: The room the message lives in: the record key of a `space.roomy.space.room` record in the space's repo.

author.description: Who the message is from. The space's own DID for a system message.

actor.description: Who performed the action, when that is not the author — the acting DID of a system message, which the author is the space for.

content.description: The message body. A message carries content, a `system` fact, or a `forwardOf` reference, never more than one.

data.description: The body bytes. A record exported from the change feed carries them as a `$bytes` marker; the same bytes are what a publish step uploads as a blob.

system.description: A message whose text a rule derives rather than the log carrying it. The record states the fact; the reader renders it.

linkToRoom.description: The linked room: the record key of the room this message announces.

isCreationLink.description: True when the message announces a room's creation, false when it links an existing room into another.

forwardOf.description: Message keys this message forwards. A forward carries no body of its own.

extensions.description: The message's extensions, unopened: `space.roomy.extension.discordMessageOrigin.v0` and its siblings.
